patch_description: The multi-start version (2.28) actually regressed below the best deterministic staggered-lattice program (2.45), and it is ~9x slower. The best-performing pattern is a single staggered hex-like seed [5,4,5,4,5,3] with wide spacing, refined by the grow/relax loop with the water-filling radius solver. I propose reverting to that single deterministic seed (dropping the costly multi-start), and then adding the recommended final greedy local-search pass: after refinement, try small center shifts for each circle (±δ in x and y, with shrinking δ), re-solving radii each time and keeping any shift that increases the total. This directly targets irregular center placement headroom while the monotone repair in compute_max_radii guarantees feasibility, and removing the multi-start makes the search affordable within the time budget.
